name: Anbernic RG35XX family (H700)
summary: Anbernic's Allwinner H700 handhelds whose operating system lives on an SD card. KNULLI, ROCKNIX, muOS and spruceOS each ship a separate image per model; the stock card is the whole system, so a replacement OS is a card swap and going back to stock is a card write.
openByDesign: the OS lives on the SD card, so any H700 model boots a card written with another system

specs.cpu: Allwinner H700, 4x Arm Cortex-A53 (1.5 GHz vendor claim; ROCKNIX runs 1.4 GHz with a 1.5 GHz overclock option)
specs.memory: 1 GB LPDDR4 (documented for the RG35XX H; KNULLI and ROCKNIX list the same H700 for the sibling models)
specs.storage: SD card only on the documented model (ROCKNIX lists no eMMC); dual TF slots up to 512 GB
specs.media: 3.5-inch IPS, 640x480 on the RG35XX H; screen sizes for sibling models are not sourced here

variants.storage: 16 GB or 64 GB TF card by SKU; dual TF slots up to 512 GB (vendor states both 16 GB and 64 GB)
variants.notes: Horizontal shell in Black, Purple Translucent and White Translucent. Sold with a 16 GB card in the shop while the spec box says 64 GB; ROCKNIX lists no eMMC, so the card is the system.

specs.cpu: Allwinner H700, 4x Arm Cortex-A53, 1.5 GHz vendor claim
specs.storage: SD card only, no eMMC; dual TF slots up to 512 GB

firmware.version: Per model; latest builds are served from Anbernic's System Update index (2026-05 builds for RG35XX H, RG35XX SP, RG28XX and RG40XX H; 2026-01 post for RG35XX Pro, RG34XX, RG40XX V and RG CubeXX).

homebrew.name: KNULLI
homebrew.firmware: Per-model image (knulli-h700-<model>); boots from SD card with no stock-firmware dependency.
homebrew.summary: Batocera-based retro gaming OS for Allwinner H700 handhelds. It boots from a prepared SD card and leaves the stock card untouched.

compatibility.note: KNULLI publishes a dedicated H700 image for each of these models. The RG35XX 2024 reuses the rg35xx-plus image.
KNULLI's device table does not name these models (checked 2026-10-29).

requirements: A compatible Anbernic H700 model from KNULLI's device table.
A good-quality SD card; a second card is safer than reusing the stock card.
A computer with an SD card reader and an image writer (Rufus, balenaEtcher, Raspberry Pi Imager or dd).
7-Zip to extract the image; do not format the Linux partitions that Windows cannot read.
warnings: KNULLI ships a separate image per model; an rg35xx-h image does not boot an RG35XX SP or Plus.
Revised H700 units exist; KNULLI's Scarab release notes newly supported revised H700 devices in the RG XX series.
Never let Windows format the partitions it cannot read after writing the image.

homebrew.name: ROCKNIX
homebrew.firmware: Per-model H700 image; mainline Linux with Panfrost, boots from SD card.
homebrew.summary: Mainline-Linux retro gaming OS with Panfrost graphics for the Allwinner H700 models. It boots from SD card and leaves internal storage untouched.

compatibility.note: ROCKNIX lists these models as separate device pages. The RG35XX 2024 is covered by the Plus entry.
ROCKNIX's device index does not list the RG34XX SP (checked 2026-10-29).

requirements: A compatible Anbernic H700 model from ROCKNIX's device index.
A good-quality SD card.
A computer with an SD card reader and an image writer (Rufus, balenaEtcher, Raspberry Pi Imager or dd).
Do not format the Linux partitions that Windows cannot read.
warnings: ROCKNIX ships a separate image per model; cross-flashing does not boot.
Revised H700 units may need a newer ROCKNIX release.
Never let Windows format the partitions it cannot read after writing the image.

homebrew.name: muOS (MustardOS)
homebrew.firmware: Per-model H700 image (muOS 2606.0 Andromeda); written to an SD card with an image writer.
homebrew.summary: Lightweight Linux OS (MustardOS frontend plus RetroArch cores) for H700 handhelds. The image is written to an SD card; the stock card is untouched.

compatibility.note: muOS 2606.0 lists these H700 models on its supported-devices page; it labels the RG28XX and RG34XX rows 'RG28XX H' and 'RG34XX H'.

requirements: A compatible Anbernic H700 model from muOS's supported-devices page.
An SD card of 16 GB or larger.
A computer with an SD card reader and an image writer that reads .img.gz files.
warnings: muOS writes a whole-disk image; the target card is erased.
muOS ships a separate image per model; cross-flashing does not boot.

homebrew.name: spruceOS
homebrew.firmware: Frontend on top of the vendor OS; needs a 'BaseOS' TF1 image on this family.
homebrew.summary: Frontend and game launcher that runs on top of Anbernic's stock OS. On the XX models it needs a prepared BaseOS image on the first card.

compatibility.note: spruceOS lists these models and requires a BaseOS TF1 image for them.
spruceOS's supported-device list does not name the RG35XX 2024 (checked 2026-10-29).

requirements: A compatible Anbernic model from spruceOS's supported-device list.
A FAT32 SD card.
The spruceOS archive extracted to the card (no image write for devices that do not need a BaseOS image).
A BaseOS TF1 image where spruceOS requires one.
warnings: spruceOS keeps the stock OS underneath by design; it is not a full OS replacement.
The 'RG SP' row in spruceOS's list is not placed in this family by any other source checked here.

homebrew.name: Batocera.linux
homebrew.firmware: SD card image (Batocera 43.1 handheld build); written to an SD card.
homebrew.summary: Batocera.linux's own handheld build, the upstream project ROCKNIX and KNULLI derive from. Written to an SD card.

compatibility.note: Batocera 43.1 lists 'RG40XX V (original panel)' only; the other H700 models in this record are not on its handheld list. The page gives the download only, not install steps.

requirements: A device from Batocera's handheld download list.
A good-quality SD card.
A computer with an SD card reader and an image writer.
warnings: The listed build is for the RG40XX V with the original panel; check the panel before writing.

homebrew.name: Anbernic stock firmware
homebrew.firmware: Per-model image stamped YYMMDD; latest builds from Anbernic's System Update index.
homebrew.summary: Anbernic's own Linux OS image, written to the first SD card. It restores the factory system; nothing inside the device is overwritten.

compatibility.note: Vendor image per model; the version string is a build stamp (for example RG35XXH-V1.2.4-EN16GB-260526), not a firmware version.

requirements: Download the image for the exact model from Anbernic's System Update page.
Unzip the download with 7-Zip.
Format the TF1 card FAT32 with Rufus.
Write the image and boot.
A PC, card reader and network connection, as Anbernic assumes.
warnings: The wrong model image does not boot, and the models look alike.
On RG35XX Plus and RG35XX 2024, the vendor notes that after installing the OS on the 16 GB version the SD card cannot be expanded and ROMs cannot be installed on it.
No documented downgrade path; going back means writing an older vendor image.
Stock version strings are build-stamped and easy to misread as dates.

os.title: Custom firmware on SD card
os.note: These projects replace or sit on top of the stock OS on an SD card. The device boots whatever card is inserted; no bootloader unlock is involved.

recovery.title: Restore the official system software
recovery.note: Use Anbernic's per-model image to rebuild the stock card. A full write replaces the card's contents.

tools.note: An image writer prepares the card; none of these is a firmware flasher for the device itself.
